in_marathi.name: Vineesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Wisdom
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vineesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Vineesh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vidhish', which means 'God of Wisdom'. It is a name that signifies intelligence, knowledge and the pursuit of knowledge. The name is also associated with victory and strength.
